rules.title: Owner Move-In and Ellis Act Relocation Assistance Payments (2026 adjustment)
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance; Berkeley Ellis Implementation Ordinance
rules.quote: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction. The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.
rules.summary: Landlords must pay relocation assistance to tenants evicted for owner move-in or under the Ellis Act, with the standard payment set at $19,413 and an additional $6,471 for qualifying households as of January 1, 2026.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Annual increases for owner move-in and Ellis Act eviction relocation assistance payments go into effect January 1, 2026.
